is spawned from Rust and is no job of the page's, so the page's
gameRunning() never sees it. The page's at-start look for updates,
started as the hidden page loads, could therefore update the game's
mods in the moments after the shortcut had started it, against the
rule that mods are never updated while the game runs.

commits.headline: feat(touch): add rac2 strafe toggle button (#567)
commits.author: nickyyOO
commits.body:
* feat(touch): add rac2 strafe toggle button

A tap holds L2 (the game's strafe) until the next tap. The toggle lets go
in menus, loads, scenes and while the hero is dying (the pad shows the
default set then), so it is off when play comes back.

* feat(touch): larger rac2 strafe button under the look button

A left-side action can now take its own place with "at" (0 lowest to 2).
Strafe takes the lowest place, large; the look button moves a bit up.

commits.headline: feat(sdk): switches and choices in a mod's developer menu, interface 1.19 (#569)
commits.author: farfeduc
commits.body:
A mod's developer menu (1.10) had only rows to press, and OpenRAC's
menu pauses the game while it is open: a press waits in the queue
until the menu closes and the game ticks again, so a row whose label
says a state ("Invincibility: Off") stays as it was however often the
player presses it. The menu has switches and choices for the port's
own settings; mods could not use them.

Interface 1.19 adds developer_menu_switch, developer_menu_choice and
developer_menu_value at the end of the table. The…

commits.headline: docs(sdk): native mods load on Android (#570)
commits.author: farfeduc
commits.body:
The port loads a native mod on Android when its release has an
android-arm64 build, and the template's workflow makes one (MODS.md,
section 2, since #110). Three guides still said Android loads only script
mods: where-mods-live.md's Android section, troubleshooting.md's "no
library for this platform" row, and the guides' index ("Runs on"). They
now say what MODS.md says, with the platforms the template builds.

commits.headline: fix(rac1-ntsc): a build with the disc stops in hostgen's assembly guard (#575)
commits.author: farfeduc
commits.body:
Since #536 a rac1-ntsc build made with the disc failed in hostgen: four
functions the decompilation's C calls, and that have no C in the port,
were translated from the disc's assembly, and the guard counts those.
Without the disc each is a stub of kind no-c, which it does not count,
so CI never saw it. Two of them did nothing in such a build:

- sceVu0ScaleVector (FUN_001251e8), which the level moby hit test calls:
  rac1_version.h now maps rac1/host's version (PAL's func_00125328) to
  it, as…
